tool_args.rationale: The signatures and verified branch rule support the five-parameter coupled RK4 memory ODE, and the horizon is substantial relative to the characteristic time. Five training rows leave genuine parameter ambiguity; the available extra fine trajectory batch is the indicated way to obtain at least eight rows before fitting and confirmation.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the 5-parameter coupled siphon-memory ODE from the five initial rows
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Five observations do not identify the five coupled parameters robustly or support fresh confirmation.
It is explicitly nuisance data and does not resolve the trajectory/parameter identifiability issue.
Neither probe appears in the available cost menu, and the stated supercritical branch applies only above s_grad 2.36; current rows are at or below 2.2.
